name: echo kaiju
description: Proposal, the giant monster film format with no named monster, 40 cell lattice (12 px cells, the creature at 2x standing waist deep in a night city of near black towers with gold windows, a crescent moon and two searchlights sweeping the sky behind it): it blinks and stomps twice, the skyline jolting and dust kicking up, a tower by its mouth wobbling, it roars with claws up, eyes squeezed into chevrons and a toothy mouth, one big stomp tips the tower over onto the street in a cloud of dust, it goes small eyed with a round mouth, then crouches, reaches down with a forearm, stands the tower back up and straightens with happy arches and a smile; judge whether it reads at a glance as a giant over a city, whether the falling tower reads as a tower turning about its base, and whether the roar stays friendly.
